phase_name: Reader Hardening — Item C Decision and the General Empty-Value Detection Signal

objectives.description: Record Item C decision in the script's header comment (no permissive top-level phases fallback); update output-field docs
Add evidence_suspect/evidence_reason to emit() and to the emitted JSON object as new named fields (braced positional params 12/13)

Implement the general detection signal (PHASES_ZERO_ON_SUCCESS, ARTIFACTS_SHAPE_MISMATCH) on the recovered=true path, with jq-failure rc capture folded into ARTIFACTS_SHAPE_MISMATCH as corroboration rather than being discarded
objectives.note: Design decision: evidence_suspect/evidence_reason are computed ONLY inside the researched|planned|implemented (recovered=true) case branch. The three recovered=false-with-parsed-json branches (in_progress, default/STATUS_NOT_SUCCESS) and the three fully-unrecoverable branches (META_MISSING/STALE/UNPARSEABLE) all pass false/"NONE" literally, unchanged in spirit from before this phase -- this matches the phase's own verification section, which only exercises the recovered=true fixtures, and avoids introducing new behavior on paths the plan does not test.

objectives.description: Verify by construction: re-run all three Phase 1 fixtures (control_correct, defect1_topmeta, defect2_barestrings) against the modified script; confirm pre-existing fields byte-identical and new fields match expected values; confirm bash -n passes; confirm the two .metadata. phase-count read lines are unchanged
objectives.note: control (AFTER): evidence_suspect=false, evidence_reason="NONE"; all pre-existing fields identical to Phase 1 control capture except window_start (expected, computed per-invocation). defect1 (AFTER): evidence_suspect=true, evidence_reason="PHASES_ZERO_ON_SUCCESS"; phases_completed/phases_total STILL 0/0 (values not silently corrected -- Item C decision holding). defect2 (AFTER): evidence_suspect=true, evidence_reason="ARTIFACTS_SHAPE_MISMATCH"; artifact_path still ""; stderr still carries the three 'Cannot index string with string' jq error lines (not suppressed, per the plan's explicit instruction not to simply append 2>/dev/null). All three exit codes unchanged from Phase 1 (0/0/0). `bash -n` passed. `grep -n '.metadata.phases_completed'` confirms both original read lines are unchanged character-for-character. Verified against the SOURCE-STORE script directly (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/...), never against the deployed .claude/ copy, per the binding no-redeploy constraint.
